class_evidence: 15 two-class datasets built from 13 UCI sources (Sec. 5, Table 3, pp.24-25); the paper considers only two-class problems (Sec. 4.1, p.22). C4.5, 10-fold CV, AUC (Tables 4-7).
reduced_multiclass: Smallest class vs the rest merged (Sec. 5, p.24), e.g. Vehicle van, New-thyroid hypo, E.Coli iMU, Satimage 4, Flag white, Glass, Nursery; Letter gives Letter-a (a vs rest) and Letter-vowel (all vowels vs rest); Splice gives two one-vs-rest sets (Table 3).
smote_explanation: SMOTE first balances the training set (Sec. 5, p.25); then Tomek-link pairs are removed from both classes, or, in the ENN variant, every example misclassified by its 3 nearest neighbours is removed from both classes (Sec. 4.3, pp.23-24; Fig. 2). Seeds, neighbours and placement are as in SMOTE; the only addition is cleaning after generation.
corrections: None to category or decision points. Evidence text: not every set is smallest class vs rest (Letter-vowel merges vowels; Splice gives two sets).
flags: Uses HVDM for k-NN (Sec. 4.2, p.22); whether SMOTE's own neighbour search uses HVDM is not stated. Cleaning removes original as well as synthetic examples.

class_evidence: 4 datasets used as two-class problems (Sec. 4, Table 2, p.883): Circle (simulated), Pima, Satimage (class 4 vs the rest), Haberman. The paper studies only two-class problems (Sec. 4, p.883). C4.5, 3 x 10-fold CV, TP rate and F-value (p.884).
reduced_multiclass: Satimage: class 4 vs all remaining classes merged (Sec. 4, p.883; Table 2).
smote_explanation: For each minority point its m nearest neighbours in the whole training set are found (Sec. 3, Steps 1-2, p.882); points with only majority neighbours are treated as noise, and points with at least half majority neighbours form the DANGER set, which are the only seeds. In v1 each DANGER seed interpolates towards s of its k = 5 minority neighbours with lambda ~ U(0,1) as in SMOTE (Step 4, p.882). v2 also interpolates towards the seed's nearest majority neighbour with lambda in (0, 0.5), so those points stay near the seed (pp.882-883).
corrections: None. Neighbour choice and Placement rule change only in v2; v1 changes only Seed selection.
flags: Distance metric not stated; m tuned so that DANGER holds about half of the minority class (p.884).
